entities.name: Kairat Yeraliyev
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kairat Yeraliyev is a Kazakh boxer who competes in the bantamweight division. He won bronze medals at the 2013 World Championships and 2014 Asian Games, but was eliminated in the second round of the 2016 Summer Olympics.
